name: loonbids
description: Find Canadian tenders for your business (federal, Ontario, Quebec, Toronto, Saskatchewan, Yukon), read the notices, see who won similar contracts, and get email alerts for new matches, from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: LoonBids helps contractors and other businesses find tenders across Canada and decide which ones to bid on. Ask for work the way you'd describe it, like "construction tenders in Toronto closing this month", and LoonBids searches open notices from federal buyers, the City of Toronto, Quebec (including municipalities), Saskatchewan and Yukon, with a link to each buyer's own page. Open a notice to check its closing time, contact, documents and requirements, and ask which ones fit your company. See who won similar federal contracts, and for how much, before you price a bid. Save searches as email alerts; you approve each change on a card in the chat. You connect a LoonBids account the first time. LoonBids is independent and isn't affiliated with any government.
defaultPrompt: Find open construction bids in Toronto.
Who has won federal roofing contracts in Ontario, and for how much?
Email me every morning about new construction tenders in Saskatchewan.

positive.description: Search open construction tenders once connected
positive.prompt: Find open construction tenders in Toronto.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open construction notices from City of Toronto divisions and federal buyers in Ontario, with buyer, closing date and tender number. Federal notices link to the notice itself; City of Toronto notices link to the City's bids portal, where the tender number finds it. Asks the user to connect their LoonBids account first if they haven't.

positive.description: Check a tender's closing time and requirements
positive.prompt: Find open City of Toronto construction tenders, then open the one closing soonest and tell me its closing time, contact, and any site meeting, bonding or insurance requirements it mentions.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, then opens the notice closing soonest and gives its closing date and time (converted from UTC), buyer, contact and documents, with a link to the buyer's page (for City of Toronto, the bids portal and the tender number to search). Lists the site meeting, bonding and insurance requirements the notice states, and says plainly when it doesn't mention them and the full documents need checking.

positive.prompt: Who has won federal roofing contracts in Ontario, and for how much?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists past federal roofing awards in Ontario with supplier, value, award date and department, each linked to its award notice, and summarizes the typical contract value and who wins most often.

positive.prompt: Set up a LoonBids alert that emails me new construction tenders in Toronto every morning.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews what the alert would match today, checks the name, filters and daily frequency with the user, then shows an approval card. After the reviewer clicks Approve, the card confirms the new alert and the address its emails go to.

positive.description: Review alerts and fit to the company
positive.prompt: What alerts do I have, and which recent matches fit my company?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's alerts, shows recent matches, and says which fit the company info (a small general contractor in the Greater Toronto Area doing building renovations, roofing and facility repairs, typical contracts of $100,000 to $2 million) and why the others don't.

negative.description: Submitting a bid is out of scope: LoonBids has no tool for it, so the assistant should explain that bids go through the buyer's own portal and give the notice link.
negative.prompt: Submit a bid on this tender for me.
negative.expected_behavior: No LoonBids tool submits anything. The assistant explains that bids go through the buyer's own portal and gives the notice link.

negative.description: LoonBids covers Canadian public tenders only, so it should not be used for US contracts; if called, it finds nothing and the assistant says it covers Canada only.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant doesn't use LoonBids, or if it does, finds nothing and says LoonBids covers Canadian public tenders only.

negative.description: Unrelated request: LoonBids should not be used at all.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: LoonBids isn't used, since the request has nothing to do with tenders.

review.commerce_description: LoonBids does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Users can connect an existing LoonBids account, and tools only explain plan limits.

publication.release_notes: First release: search tenders across Canada, open a notice to check its closing time and requirements, see which matches fit your company, look up past federal contract awards, and manage email alerts from the chat.
